fits.method: v1: ln(Total) = ln(a) + b*ln(BW) by unweighted least squares over all results; scale = 500 / 99th percentile of Total/(a*BW^b) over all results, both sexes
v2: ln(Total) = ln(a) + b*ln(BW) by least squares, each lifter's results weighted to a total of 1; scale = 500 / 99th percentile of lifters' best Total/(a*BW^b), both sexes pooled

about: Every N-Score fit PLStats has published, oldest first. N-Score = Total / (a * BW^b) * scale, with a and b per sex. The fit is redone on each data refresh, so a score is only exactly comparable with scores from the same fit (same id).
